sections.heading: Identity and current status
sections.body:
- Project ID: `claude-code`
- Canonical name: Claude Code (`claim-claude-code-w2-identity`)
- Current status: active repository; latest checked release v2.1.226 (`claim-claude-code-w2-status`, `claim-claude-code-w2-version`)
- Last source-backed identity check: 2026-08-10

sections.heading: What it is and is not
sections.body:
- What it is: a runtime spanning local, cloud, and remotely supervised execution (`claim-claude-code-w2-primary-type`, `claim-claude-code-w2-execution-topology`, `claim-claude-code-w2-unique`).
- What it is not: the native mobile apps are clients, not execution hosts (`claim-claude-code-w2-not-mobile-host`). Claude Tag is adjacent and is not merged into Claude Code runtime identity (`claim-claude-code-w2-surface-claude-tag`).

sections.heading: Architecture and agent-loop ownership
sections.body:
- Primary type: `runtime` (`claim-claude-code-w2-primary-type`)
- Agent-loop owner: Claude Code owns the model-tool and session harness; the selected Claude model supplies reasoning (`claim-claude-code-w2-loop-owner`).
- Architecture: execution can stay on the same device, run in Anthropic or organization cloud infrastructure, or stay local while Remote Control clients supervise it (`claim-claude-code-w2-execution-topology`).

- Surface IDs: `surface-claude-code-cli-local`, `surface-claude-code-cli-cloud-dispatch`, `surface-claude-code-cli-remote-control-host`, `surface-claude-code-vscode`, `surface-claude-code-jetbrains`, `surface-claude-code-desktop-local`, `surface-claude-code-desktop-cloud`, `surface-claude-code-desktop-ssh`, `surface-claude-code-desktop-wsl`, `surface-claude-code-web-cloud`, `surface-claude-code-ios-cloud`, `surface-claude-code-android-cloud`, `surface-claude-code-ios-remote-control`, `surface-claude-code-android-remote-control`, `surface-claude-code-remote-control-relay`, `surface-claude-code-ios-dispatch`, `surface-claude-code-android-dispatch`, `surface-claude-code-slack`, `surface-claude-code-claude-tag`, `surface-claude-code-channels-telegram`, `surface-claude-code-channels-discord`, `surface-claude-code-channels-imessage`, `surface-claude-code-self-hosted-cloud`, `surface-claude-code-github-actions`, `surface-claude-code-gitlab-ci`, `surface-claude-code-code-review`, `surface-claude-code-cloud-routines`, `surface-claude-code-desktop-scheduled`, `surface-claude-code-agent-sdk`, `surface-claude-code-chrome`, `surface-claude-code-computer-use`, `surface-claude-code-generic-ssh`, `surface-claude-code-private-network`, `surface-claude-code-termux`.
- Execution location: same-device local, vendor cloud, organization-operated self-hosted cloud, or a user-controlled SSH host (`claim-claude-code-w2-execution-topology`).

sections.heading: Model/auth/provider strategy
sections.body:
- Model strategy: Claude models are selected within the Claude Code harness; provider and surface feature parity varies (`claim-claude-code-w2-loop-owner`, `claim-claude-code-w2-drawback`).
- Auth strategy: subscription OAuth, Console, cloud credentials, gateway tokens, API keys, bearer tokens, helper scripts, and long-lived OAuth tokens are documented (`claim-claude-code-w2-auth`).
- Provider support: Claude subscription, Anthropic Console, Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry, Claude Platform on AWS, and organization gateways (`claim-claude-code-w2-provider-support`).

sections.heading: Context, memory, compaction, and session behavior
sections.body:
- Context behavior: local sessions are saved continuously; context includes project instructions and tool results (`claim-claude-code-w2-context-sessions`, `claim-claude-code-w2-memory`).
- Memory: CLAUDE.md plus repository-scoped auto memory (`claim-claude-code-w2-memory`).
- Compaction: automatic old-output clearing and conversation summaries, plus `/compact` (`claim-claude-code-w2-compaction`).
- Session behavior: local resume, fork, rewind, and plaintext JSONL persistence (`claim-claude-code-w2-context-sessions`). Desktop SSH resume and persistence remain unknown.

sections.heading: Tools, extensions, MCP, skills, hooks, and APIs
sections.body:
- Tools: the runtime owns tools and execution; the extension overview covers the supported tool and context stack (`claim-claude-code-w2-loop-owner`, `claim-claude-code-w2-extension-stack`).
- Extensions: CLAUDE.md, code intelligence, MCP, subagents, agent teams, hooks, plugins, and skills (`claim-claude-code-w2-extension-stack`).
- MCP: supported within the extension stack (`claim-claude-code-w2-extension-stack`).
- Skills: supported within the extension stack (`claim-claude-code-w2-extension-stack`).
- Hooks: supported within the extension stack (`claim-claude-code-w2-extension-stack`).
- APIs: Claude Agent SDK for Python and TypeScript (`claim-claude-code-w2-surface-sdk`).

sections.heading: Orchestration and parallelism
sections.body:
- Orchestration: experimental agent teams use a lead, independent teammates, shared tasks, and peer messages (`claim-claude-code-w2-orchestration`).
- Parallelism: agent-team teammates are independent sessions; no cross-surface universal parallelism claim is made (`claim-claude-code-w2-orchestration`).

sections.heading: Isolation, permissions, security, and data path
sections.body:
- Isolation: Bash sandbox on macOS, Linux, and WSL2; native Windows is not supported by that sandbox (`claim-claude-code-w2-permissions-isolation`). Cloud and self-hosted boundaries remain separate.
- Permissions: allow/ask/deny rules and explicit action review (`claim-claude-code-w2-permissions-isolation`).
- Security: local sandbox and permission controls do not replace cloud VM or self-hosted controls (`claim-claude-code-w2-permissions-isolation`, `claim-claude-code-w2-data-path`).
- Data path: local provider traffic and plaintext local transcripts differ from hosted isolated-VM and account-retention paths (`claim-claude-code-w2-data-path`).

sections.body:
- Interface and surface IDs:
  - Local CLI/IDE/Desktop: `surface-claude-code-cli-local`, `surface-claude-code-vscode`, `surface-claude-code-jetbrains`, `surface-claude-code-desktop-local`, `surface-claude-code-desktop-wsl` (`claim-claude-code-w2-surface-local-clients`, `claim-claude-code-w2-surface-desktop-topologies`).
  - Cloud and self-hosted: `surface-claude-code-cli-cloud-dispatch`, `surface-claude-code-desktop-cloud`, `surface-claude-code-web-cloud`, `surface-claude-code-self-hosted-cloud` (`claim-claude-code-w2-surface-cloud-web`, `claim-claude-code-w2-surface-self-hosted`).
  - Product remote routes: `surface-claude-code-desktop-ssh`, `surface-claude-code-cli-remote-control-host`, `surface-claude-code-remote-control-relay` (`claim-claude-code-w2-surface-desktop-topologies`, `claim-claude-code-w2-surface-remote-control`).
  - Native mobile clients: `surface-claude-code-ios-cloud`, `surface-claude-code-android-cloud`, `surface-claude-code-ios-remote-control`, `surface-claude-code-android-remote-control`, `surface-claude-code-ios-dispatch`, `surface-claude-code-android-dispatch` (`claim-claude-code-w2-surface-mobile`). First-party mobile-web support was not established.
  - Messaging: `surface-claude-code-slack`, `surface-claude-code-claude-tag`, `surface-claude-code-channels-telegram`, `surface-claude-code-channels-discord`, `surface-claude-code-channels-imessage` (`claim-claude-code-w2-surface-slack`, `claim-claude-code-w2-surface-claude-tag`, `claim-claude-code-w2-surface-channels`).
  - Automation/API/browser control: `surface-claude-code-github-actions`, `surface-claude-code-gitlab-ci`, `surface-claude-code-code-review`, `surface-claude-code-cloud-routines`, `surface-claude-code-desktop-scheduled`, `surface-claude-code-agent-sdk`, `surface-claude-code-chrome`, `surface-claude-code-computer-use` (`claim-claude-code-w2-surface-automation`, `claim-claude-code-w2-surface-sdk`, `claim-claude-code-w2-surface-chrome`, `claim-claude-code-w2-surface-computer-use`).
  - Generic or unverified routes: `surface-claude-code-generic-ssh`, `surface-claude-code-private-network`, `surface-claude-code-termux` (`claim-claude-code-w2-access-generic-ssh`, `claim-claude-code-w2-access-private-network`, `claim-claude-code-w2-access-termux`).
- Remote behavior: Remote Control uses a vendor relay but executes locally; Desktop SSH executes remotely; cloud sessions execute in cloud infrastructure (`claim-claude-code-w2-surface-remote-control`, `claim-claude-code-w2-surface-desktop-topologies`, `claim-claude-code-w2-surface-cloud-web`).
- Mobile behavior: native cloud clients, native Remote Control clients, and Dispatch are distinct. First-party mobile web and Termux remain unknown (`claim-claude-code-w2-surface-mobile`, `claim-claude-code-w2-access-termux`).
- Background behavior: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Code Review, cloud Routines, and local Desktop schedules have distinct runner and continuity rules (`claim-claude-code-w2-surface-automation`).

sections.heading: Pricing, license, maintenance, and lock-in
sections.body:
- Pricing: official pages conflict on Team Premium (`claim-claude-code-w2-pricing-page`, `claim-claude-code-w2-pricing-deployment`).
- License: the repository README names Anthropic's Commercial Terms of Service and Privacy Policy; a separate open-source license was not established (`claim-claude-code-w2-license-terms`).
- Maintenance: active repository and v2.1.226 snapshot (`claim-claude-code-w2-status`, `claim-claude-code-w2-version`).
- Lock-in: provider routes exist, but feature parity and hosted/subscription surfaces vary (`claim-claude-code-w2-provider-support`, `claim-claude-code-w2-drawback`).

sections.heading: Lineage and compatibility edges
sections.body:
- Lineage claims: no Claude Code-owned `fork_of` or `built_on` claim was established; the Agent SDK is a distinct API surface sharing the engine.
- Relationship edges: no new Wave 2 outgoing Claude Code relationship row. Existing baseline inbound compatibility tuples were not copied.

sections.heading: Unique edge, meaningful drawbacks, best fit, and not-for
sections.body:
- Unique edge: shared engine across distinct local, cloud, mobile-client, and Remote Control topologies (`claim-claude-code-w2-unique`).
- Meaningful drawbacks: provider feature gaps, subscription gates, cloud setup, plaintext local transcripts, and self-hosted operations (`claim-claude-code-w2-drawback`).
- Best fit: documented intended users include terminal and IDE developers, teams, and users needing cloud continuation or remote supervision (`claim-claude-code-w2-intended-user`). This is not a recommendation.
- Not-for: mobile apps do not execute code; generic private-network and Termux execution remain unverified (`claim-claude-code-w2-not-mobile-host`, `claim-claude-code-w2-access-private-network`, `claim-claude-code-w2-access-termux`).
